hints.title: Order Invariance
hints.text: The problem asks for pairs (i, j) with i < j. Since addition is commutative, sorting the array preserves all valid pair sums.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Range
hints.text: Sort nums and initialize left at 0 and right at n - 1.

hints.title: Batch Counting
hints.text: If nums[left] + nums[right] < target, then all elements between left and right paired with nums[left] also satisfy the condition. Add right - left to the answer and advance left.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by two-pointer opposite convergence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested pair iteration is slower than sorting with two pointers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sorting requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply two-pointer counting on a sorted array to batch count valid pairs in linear time after sorting.
